description: This file contains utility functions for filtering and identifying metric columns, specifically handling percentage metrics and regular metrics within a data visualization context in Superset.

methods.name: shouldSkipMetricColumn
methods.description: Determines if a column should be skipped based on metric filtering logic, especially handling prefixed percentage metrics.

methods.name: isRegularMetric
methods.description: Checks if a given column name corresponds to a regular metric in the form data.

methods.name: isPercentMetric
methods.description: Checks if a given column name corresponds to a percentage metric in the form data.
